title: Rift-Eye
text: A second pupil opens only when reality is weakest.
flavor: It sees the wound before the world admits it exists.
origin: An anomaly folded sight inward and left a breach watching from behind the eye.
burdenText: A natural 1 on an Anomaly test inflicts 1 Wound after resolution.
adaptationText: Once per round, reduce a Signal or Guile Anomaly difficulty by 1 before rolling.
penalty: A natural 1 inflicts 1 Wound after resolution.
relief: Purge this Scar at the Sable Machine Choir.
upside: Reduce one eligible Anomaly difficulty each round.
